Platform Operations Monitoring & Optimization: Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize the performance and reliability of data systems and platforms. Talent Development: Support the professional development of team members, identifying training needs, and fostering a collaborative and dynamic environment to leverage data management and analytics expertise. Strong expertise in SQL, data modeling, and ETL pipeline design using tools like Informatica PowerCenter, Alteryx, or SSIS.
